x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
numerator, denominator = 0, 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    lower = (i * x) // y
    upper = lower + 1

    def update_fraction(candidate, index):
        nonlocal numerator, denominator
        diff1 = abs((denominator * y) * ((x * index) - (y * candidate)))
        diff2 = abs((y * index) * ((denominator * x) - (numerator * y)))
        if diff1 < diff2 or (diff1 == diff2 and index < denominator):
            denominator = index
            numerator = candidate

    update_fraction(lower, i)
    update_fraction(upper, i)

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
</translated_code>
